name: Executive order of June 3, 1884 amending the Turtle Mountain restoration order of March 29, 1884
nations: Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians
promises: This was an executive order, not a treaty. It amended the order of March 29, 1884 so that Township 162 North, Range 70 West was set apart for the Turtle Mountain band in place of Township 163 North, Range 71 West, which was restored to the public domain.
landTaken: One township (163 North, Range 71 West) exchanged for another; the main reduction was made by the order of March 29, 1884.
today: Same land and event as cession-1884-03-29-chippewa-turtle-mountain-band, and counted once there. The Court of Claims held in 1974 that the orders of 1882 and March 29, 1884 did not extinguish Chippewa aboriginal title; the Indian Claims Commission later dated the compensable taking to February 15, 1905 under the McCumber Agreement and held the consideration unconscionable (September 20, 1978), a separate record.
